name: 우파
wear: Pale blue enamel slim armor with three navy curved stripe motifs across the fitted torso; small pale violet branching gill shapes become paired hair clips, the broad blue tail becomes a short rounded split waist sash. Human skin and face, no animal limbs.
light: On an empty wetland boardwalk in clear early morning, the adult woman faces the camera with a lively balanced step, both empty hands relaxed and separated beside her waist. Complete head and boots inside a vertical 1024x1536 frame with margins.
casual: Inside an empty retro aquarium visitor hall at bright noon, an adult event hostess waves with one relaxed open hand at shoulder height, the other rests open on a broad reception ledge. No people or creatures in tanks, geometric blue water light. Head to above knees, both wrists and hands visible.

Opaque navy sleeveless fitted zip-front hostess mini dress with pale blue side panels, white stand collar and hem trim, secure short hem over opaque shorts, small violet branching hair pin; bare arms and legs, mainstream adult costume fashion.

In a sunlit outdoor pottery courtyard in late afternoon, kneeling upright on a broad cushion next to a low pottery turntable, shaping a small clay bowl with both hands clearly separated on opposite sides. Entire woman and feet visible, camera gently above, warm clay textures.
Opaque light blue sleeveless fitted short romper with a secure square neckline and navy waist belt, bare arms upper chest and legs; small violet stud earrings.

Under a covered basalt trail shelter during soft rainy dusk, standing side-on unfolding a plain map with both hands held apart, face turned toward viewer, river and rain behind, no writing visible on map. Both whole hands and forearms inside waist-up crop.
Opaque violet halter crop top, navy high-waisted hiking trousers and open pale blue lightweight rain vest; bare shoulders arms midriff, small blue stripe bracelet.
